landing.header: There are Many Ways to Electrify
landing.headerDescription: Tell us more about your specific requirements so we can recommend the appropriate equipment for your needs, identify incentives and estimate cost savings. Explore some project type options below.
landing.fleetMessage: Compare the total costs of fleets of electrifying your fleet. See a quick example of a fossil fuel to electric fleet comparison by clicking “Continue as Guest” below.
landing.workplaceMessage: Explore the total costs of installing chargers at your workplace.
landing.publicMessage: Analyze the total costs and revenue of providing publicly available chargers.
landing.MUDMessage: Check the total costs of installing chargers for residents at your Multi-Unit Dwellings.
landing.alertMessage: Looking to replace your existing Fossil Fuel Fleet? See how much you can save by electrifying your fossil fuel fleet, available as a guest user

default.subHeader: Select the charger that works best for your needs. Level 2 is the most common and meets the needs of 90% of projects. Estimated charging times, prices, and outputs are provided in each description to help you choose the right option for your needs.
default.alertMessage: A generic charger has been selected based on your needs.

chargerSelection.level1Tooltip: Level 1 chargers can be plugged into a standard residential 120-volt (120V) AC outlet.
chargerSelection.level2Tooltip: Level 2 chargers use 240 volts, charge at over triple the speed of a level 1 charger.
chargerSelection.level3Tooltip: Level 3 chargers (or DCFCs) are the fastest EV chargers, and are typically found in commercial or industrial applications. The installation of level 3 chargers is much more complex and expensive than level 1 or 2.
chargerSelection.chargingTime1Tooltip: How long it takes on average to charge a vehicle to 100%. Assuming a <xx> mile commute a typical EV will require <yy:> kWh of charge.A <zz> kW charger will add this charge in <aa> hours and <bb> minutes
chargerSelection.equipPrice1Tooltip: The purchase price of electric vehicle supply equipment (chargers).
chargerSelection.installPrice1Tooltip: The price of installing chargers, including labor, trenching, materials, etc.
